title: Don’t waste ur money or time
text:
Don’t waste ur money or time. Item was used, and had missing parts. Seems like I got someone else’s return, Wood doesn’t seem that sturdy either. Ugh
I contacted customer service they need a huge list of info and proof of purchase to even send replacement parts, do not recommend

product_metadata.title: DHP Maven Upholstered Platform Bed for Raised Mattres Support with Underbed Storage Drawers, No Box Spring Needed, Queen, Black Faux Leather
features: Modern low profile design with clean lines
Bentwood slat system provides great ventilation, keeping your mattress fresher
Very good back support with excellent pressure distribution
description: Who doesn’t like ample bedroom storage space—especially in an apartment or condo? When you lack the space you need to store away your favourite things, try the stylish Maven platform bed. Tucked away on each side is one roll-out drawer for extra storage—perfect for keeping your bedding, extra pillows, seasonal clothes, books, and whatever you have no shelf space for. And the bed itself? It couldn’t be more comfortable. Not only does the bentwood slat system allow air to circulate freely around your mattress—keeping it fresher for longer—it also provides ample back support and pressure distribution. Plus the metal side and centre rails and centre leg add even more support. Which means a great night’s sleep and restful mornings—plus no box spring needed! Choose from black or white faux leather or grey linen to match your bedroom décor and set the tone for your room. Pleasant dreams!
